loopIdea: The reel closes on the same slow-motion macro of the pothole rim it opens on, the tire just clear and the kicked-up dust settling back in, so the replay's impact lands again on that same edge of asphalt.
mechanicTruth: A pothole loads the wheel and suspension hard enough to bend a rim, shift the alignment, or bruise a sidewall from the inside, so the sign is usually new pulling, new shaking, or a slow leak days later rather than anything visible on a walk-around.
mode: PRODUCTION (pack only) — scheduled/unattended run, no reel-canary call made
hookText: The pothole that did not flatten your tire may still have cost you.
ctaText: Hit a bad one lately? Send this to someone who did.
onScreenTextPolicy: burned-in captions only via ffmpeg subtitle filter — never generated in-frame (Seedance/Higgsfield cannot spell; M10 preflight blocks generated text)
standingNegativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles
